decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Incineroar is at just 36 HP while Garchomp sits at 40% with Life Orb and Rough Skin, and since Garchomp outspeeds, it'll likely Earthquake again for the KO regardless. I'm weighing whether to use Darkest Lariat now against Garchomp's remaining HP, since it's neutral damage at 85 base power.

Switching to Kingambit is risky since Steel is weak to Ground and it would take heavy Earthquake damage despite decent bulk. Switching to Gholdengo faces the same Ground weakness as a Steel-type, so I'm checking whether its defenses can handle the hit.

Weighing the risk, the safest play might just be staying in with Incineroar's Darkest Lariat -- if Garchomp is faster and knocks it out with Earthquake, I lose that Pokemon but Garchomp stays in a weakened state for the next matchup.

Checking the trade: Kingambit's huge Atk stat means its Kowtow Cleave likely kills Garchomp right back after tanking the EQ hit, so that switch doesn't actually save anything either.

Switching to Kingambit still looks like the best play overall, especially since Incineroar's Intimidate has already been used up. I'll go with switching to Kingambit.

Also Hydreigon's Dark Pulse would hit Gholdengo super effectively since Dark is super effective against Ghost. With Kingambit at 47 HP likely fainting, switching to Gholdengo seems like the safer play.

Switching keeps Kingambit alive for later rather than sacrificing it, and Gholdengo stays at full health, so I'll switch to Gholdengo instead.

decisions.hidden_reasoning:
Gholdengo's at 78/164 HP with Life Orb against a full-health Hydreigon, which just hit it with Earthquake for super effective damage despite Gholdengo being a Steel type - Levitate doesn't help Hydreigon here since it's the one using the move. Gholdengo outspeeds at 149 versus Hydreigon's range, so I need to decide on the best move to capitalize on that speed advantage.

Checking type matchups: Make It Rain (Steel) would be neutral against Hydreigon's Dark/Dragon typing, while Shadow Ball is resisted since Dark resists Ghost. Make It Rain also drops Gholdengo's Sp Atk after use but with Life Orb boost could still deal significant damage to Hydreigon's healthy HP pool, and Hydreigon's own Dark-type moves won't matter much against Gholdengo's Ghost typing providing immunity.

With Gholdengo at only 78 HP, Hydreigon's Earthquake would be super effective against its Steel typing and likely finish it off, so speed matters here. Since Nasty Plot first would be too slow against a potential KO, the right call is to go for immediate damage with Make It Rain rather than setting up.
